newsitem.title: USA: Photon Dynamics expects Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Photon Dynamics expects Q2 loss.

text.p: Photon Dynamics Inc said Wednesday it expects to report a loss for the fiscal second quarter ended March 31.
It said its strategy of reinvesting earnings into the company will contribute to the anticipated loss. It also blamed delayed shipment of products due to product enhancements.
Revenues from those delayed shipments should come in the third quarter, it said.
Vince Sollitto, chief executive officer, said that while the loss will be "significant," it is expected to be limited to the second quarter.
"As a result, we anticipate returning to profitability in the third fiscal quarter," he said.
Photon said it has received a $9 million order from an existing customer, one of the three largest Korean-based manufacturers of flat panel displays.
Photon supplies test, inspection and repair systems for the flat panel display industry. It has about 100 employees worldwide, with offices in Japan and Korea.
